summary: Company history as cards wound around a vertical helix with a thin central spine. The section pins while the visitor scrolls; each step of scroll turns and lifts the helix so the next milestone faces the reader, earlier and later years curving away behind. A year rail beside the heading shows where the reader is. Phones and reduced motion get a plain vertical timeline. Handedness, step angle, rise and spine style are seeded from the brand name. Needs 4-10 real milestones (year, what happened, one line) from the brief; company history is never invented, so leave the section out without them.
